name: Haven Story - Story Mode
description: A story mode for Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. Adds an endgoal - reach Haven, the settlement that is still lit - plus an intro and an Act 1 quest hub (fetch, combat and repair jobs that unlock each other) around any shelter. Sandbox-safe: quests are optional and any NPC can give them. v1 ships Intro + Act 1; Acts 2-5 and the Haven finale are outlined in STORY.md.
